reliability._note: Per-file transcription grade. Lives here, not only in the README, because a consumer loads the manifest and may never open the prose beside it. load_corpus() refuses a corpus whose files are not all graded.

_grades.AS_SUPPLIED: Received as a data file. Not transcribed by us.
_grades.RECONCILED: Transcribed from images, then checked against an independent equation that would break if a digit were wrong.
_grades.UNRELIABLE_OCR: Transcribed from images. Treat individual fields as suspect even where the aggregate checks pass.

as_supplied/wtc2026_usa_pairing_cells.cs.reason: Arrived as a CSV. Lossy relative to the logs, but not a transcription of them.

round_values.csv.reason: Each row's label counts must reproduce the value the tool PRINTED under GOOD=+1/EVEN=0/SOFT=-10. All five rounds reconcile at zero residual, and rounds 1 and 5 are out-of-sample. A misread count breaks the equation.

opponent_decisions.csv.reason: Counts cross-check against round_values.opponent_slips per round, and the free/forced split is independently asserted.

guarantees.csv.reason: Transcribed by eye from low-contrast screenshot text in which the label letters sit immediately beside the counts. The aggregate checks below catch any error that changes a vector total or breaks the step chain, but they CANNOT catch a compensating pair of errors inside one vector. Do not fit anything to this file; it is for reverse-direction consistency checking only.
confusion_classes: S / 5 -- 'OG SN 0S OH' for '0G 5N 0S 0H': the SOFT label glyph is ambiguous with the digit in the count position
0 / O -- throughout, in both count and label position

caveats: HARD DODGE occurs zero times, so its utility weight is not identified.
One team, one event, one rival tool. No generalisation claim is supported.
Opponent verdicts are Pear Master's judgement, not an outcome.
No rating matrix exists for these boards, so rating-space models cannot be scored.
